India and UK Finalize Trade Agreement with Duty-Free Benefits

India and the United Kingdom have finalized a trade agreement that will make 99% of Indian exports duty-free. The deal, which has come into effect, aims to boost trade between the world's fifth and sixth largest economies. Specific benefits include duty-free access for over 11 lakh tonnes of Indian steel annually.
